_comment: Seed list of Australian CDR energy Product Reference Data base URIs. The fetch script appends /cds-au/v1/energy/plans to each baseUri. This is a STARTING POINT — endpoints that fail are skipped and logged by the workflow, so add/verify entries freely. Retailers hosted by the AER's Energy Made Easy follow the pattern https://cdr.energymadeeasy.gov.au/<code>. The larger retailers host their own CDR endpoints. See https://www.aer.gov.au/energy-product-reference-data for the authoritative list.
